test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **force**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Force: ** something powerful that drives or propels change. • All other given options do not show any parallelism with the given context. • Thus, the correct option is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Impact: **an effect or impression. परिणाम या प्रभाव • **Might: **used for saying that something is possible. किसी बात की ‘संभावना’ का अर्थ व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त • **Factors: **things that influences a decision, situation, etc. किसी निर्णय, स्थिति आदि को प्रभावित करने वाला तत्‍व; कारक [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** • In the given question, 'force' is a **singular noun**, which fits well with the **singular verb** 'can be'. • 'Force' here refers to an impetus or a driving power, and it gives the sentence a strong, decisive sense of direction. • The use of 'factors' is incorrect grammatically because 'factors' is a plural noun. • Using a plural noun ('factors') after 'the prime' (which expects a singular noun) and with the singular verb 'can be' would be incorrect. • The construction 'the prime factors' suggests that there are several most important factors, but the verb 'can be' implies there is one thing (Digital India) that fills this role. 220:T86f, The correct answer is **embedded**.
